questions.text: How tall is a soccer goal? (m)
questions.fact: It is 7.32 m wide. The sizes come from 8 feet by 8 yards.

questions.text: How much does an official soccer ball weigh? (g)
questions.fact: The ball is weighed dry, before the match.

questions.text: How far from the goal is the penalty spot? (m)
questions.fact: The penalty kick was created in 1891, in Ireland.

questions.text: What is the maximum length of a field in international matches? (m)
questions.fact: The minimum is 100 m. The width goes from 64 to 75 m.

questions.text: What is Usain Bolt's 100 meters world record? (s)
questions.fact: He set it in Berlin in 2009, reaching about 44 km/h.

questions.text: What is the men's high jump world record? (m)
questions.fact: Cuba's Javier Sotomayor set it in 1993, and it has never been beaten.

questions.text: How many Olympic medals did Michael Phelps win?
questions.fact: 23 of them were gold, an all-time Olympic record.

questions.text: How many minutes is an NBA game, without overtime?
questions.fact: Four quarters of 12 minutes. Under FIBA rules, games last 40 minutes.

questions.text: How high is the net in men's volleyball? (m)
questions.fact: In women's volleyball, the net is 2.24 m high.

questions.text: How long is a round in men's professional boxing? (minutes)
questions.fact: Fighters rest for 1 minute between rounds.

questions.text: How many players does each team have on the field in rugby union?
questions.fact: In rugby sevens, played at the Olympics, there are 7 per side.

questions.text: What is the maximum weight of a bowling ball? (kg)
How many dimples does a golf ball have?
questions.fact: The dimples cut air drag and make the ball fly farther.

questions.text: How many stages does the Tour de France have?
questions.fact: About 3,500 km ridden over three weeks.
